synthetic.scope: four deterministic synthetic fixture profiles measured in CI

real_attempts.denominator_authority: metrics/rust-repair-trust/corpus.json (#1702/#1579 counting authority, reused, zero attempt cases at ratification time)
real_attempts.note: Synthetic fixtures are reported separately and cannot ratify real usability; exclusions and observations stay in the denominator.

limitations: The ratification covers synthetic fixture profiles only; it makes no claim about real repair usability, route correctness, model behavior, or support readiness.

Wrong-target, missing-field, stale-action, stop-condition, and artifact-archaeology incident rates are not_measurable until the governed corpus carries attempt cases; no default field was removed on this evidence.
The synthetic profiles exercise one Rust predicate-boundary seam shape; other languages, seam kinds, and oversized witness payloads are not represented in the measured sample.
Provider, model, client, and attempt identities are execution telemetry of the future real-attempt measurement, not semantic product identity, and are not ranked here.

On the single-seam synthetic profiles the compact card wire is not smaller than the single-seam packet wire (both are small; the card carries its envelope, nine detail references, and digests). Card-vs-packet size is reported as a measurement (card_bytes_below_packet_bytes, packet_over_card_percent) and is not a ratification claim.

The synthetic profiles carry no admitted related-test target, so repair-route readiness stays closed and every measured card lacks a next action; actionable-route card wire sizes are not covered by this sample.
combinations_not_exercised: Real governed repair attempts through installed CLI and packaged VS Code (#1702) and the wider #1579 corpora
LSP and MCP RepairCard presentation (#4668, #3089, #3090); only the CLI JSON and human shapes are measured
Cross-language and non-Rust seams in the synthetic profiles
Cards whose witness or limitation content approaches the 4 KiB inline bound or the 64 KiB wire bound
Oversized-detail overflow paths beyond the default budget envelope
